notes: Verified against BUSY Master1 layouts used by Eclat and Ashish Textile. Preview is mandatory because optional contact columns vary by installation.

customers.query: SELECT a.[code] AS [external_id], a.[name] AS [name], g.[name] AS [parent_group] FROM [Master1] a LEFT JOIN [Master1] g ON a.[parentgrp] = g.[code] WHERE a.[mastertype] = 2 AND g.[name] LIKE '%Debtor%' ORDER BY a.[code]

products.query: SELECT [code] AS [external_id], [code] AS [sku], [name] AS [name] FROM [Master1] WHERE [mastertype] = 6 ORDER BY [code]
